title: Turn the conversation into a plan before the meeting is over
summary: You need a whiteboard that moves as fast as you do. Meet Zoom Whiteboard.
body_markdown:
Collaboration starts with messy ideas or a decision you need to make. Visual thinking helps you frame the conversation, think through hard problems, and get to shared understanding faster. Gone are the meetings where everyone is talking over each other.


Zoom Whiteboard is built for that kind of thinking. It's an infinite canvas inside Zoom Workplace that expands in every direction as your ideas grow. Teams can sketch, map, plan, and organize visually, whether everyone is in the same room or joining from different cities. And because it lives inside Zoom, the whiteboard is already connected to your meetings, your documents, and the intelligent tools that help you work faster.


See what you can build with Zoom Whiteboard


[Explore Zoom Whiteboard](https://www.zoom.com/en/products/online-whiteboard/)


## Visualize meeting ideas automatically as you talk


Open a Whiteboard during a Zoom meeting and the board can start listening. As your team talks through ideas, decisions, and next steps, Whiteboard drops sticky notes onto the canvas in real time, capturing the conversation without anyone having to stop and type.


You stay in the discussion while the board fills itself in. After the meeting, you can select the generated notes and group them, analyze patterns, or summarize the session into something ready to share.


## Embed live, editable documents into your whiteboards


Zoom Whiteboard has always supported third-party tools like Confluence, Jira, Coda and Notion, as well as images, videos and YouTube links. Now you can also add powerful structured documents from Zoom Canvas. Everything your team needs to make a decision can live in one place.


## Track projects and timelines with KANBAN boards and data tables


Visual collaboration gets messy on purpose. That's the point. But at some stage, loose ideas need structure. Whiteboard handles both. Data tables support tracking project milestones or timelines, running a kanban and more. It's easy to create custom views and organize anything that benefits from rows and columns.


## Familiar tools that work the way you expect


Whiteboard tools have been redesigned to mirror their physical counterparts, with a toolbar that feels familiar and engaging. Your most-used tools (selection, pan/zoom, sticky notes, pens) sit at the top, with secondary tools like templates, images, and videos a single tap away. Pin the tools you reach for most, like highlighter or eraser, to the top of the toolbar so they're always within reach.


Caption


## One plan, full access


Zoom Whiteboard comes in two tiers, and choosing between them takes about five seconds.


**Whiteboard Basic** is free and included with Zoom Workplace. You get up to three editable cloud-saved boards, which is plenty for light use or trying the product out.


**Whiteboard** is the paid license for individuals, educators, and teams that rely on visual collaboration regularly. It unlocks the full experience:


- Templates and organizational template publishing
- Custom shape libraries you can save and reuse
- Private mode for sensitive or in-progress work
- Layers for complex visual compositions
- Automated collaborative note-taking in meetings
- Data tables on the canvas
- Embedded Zoom Canvas documents
- All future advanced Whiteboard features as they ship


If you're on a qualifying Zoom Workplace bundle (Business, Enterprise, Enterprise Essentials, Enterprise Plus, or Education), the Whiteboard license is already included at no extra cost. If you're on a different plan, you can add it as a standalone license.


## Built for people and teams that need to move fast


Whether you're an IT team documenting escalation flows, a sales team mapping a complex account, a marketing team planning a campaign launch, or a support team categorizing customer feedback into themes, Whiteboard gives you a shared visual space that stays connected to the rest of your Zoom Workplace. Ideas don't stall after the meeting ends. They carry forward into chat, docs, and the next session.


The simplest way to see it is to try it.


Visual collaboration, connected to everything else you do in Zoom


[Try Zoom Whiteboard](https://zoom.us/wb/db/new?blog=true)
